description: Historical price, market cap, and volume time series for a coin. Two modes: recent (last N days; granularity auto-scales — ≤1 day → ~5-min, 2–90 → hourly, >90 → daily) or range (explicit Unix-second from/to). Returns timestamped point arrays. Use for trend/charting questions, not the current snapshot (use coingecko_get_prices for that). The id must be a CoinGecko slug (resolve tickers with coingecko_search_coins). Chart timestamps are milliseconds.

anyOf.description: Number of days back from now.

days.description: recent mode: number of days back, or "max" for full history. Required when mode=recent.

from.description: range mode: start time as a Unix timestamp in SECONDS. Required when mode=range.

id.description: CoinGecko slug (e.g. "bitcoin"). Not a ticker — resolve with coingecko_search_coins.

mode.description: recent: last N days (use days). range: explicit window (use from and to as Unix seconds).

to.description: range mode: end time as a Unix timestamp in SECONDS. Required when mode=range.

vs_currency.description: Currency to denominate the series in. Single currency; defaults to "usd".

name: coingecko_get_market_chart

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `coin_not_found`: Upstream returned 404 for the slug — it is not a recognized CoinGecko id. `invalid_range`: Mode/parameter mismatch — range mode without both from and to, or recent mode without days. `rate_limited`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 429 — the shared keyless pool is throttled, or the Demo-tier quota was hit. `upstream_unreachable`: CoinGecko was unreachable or returned a 5xx/HTML error after all retry attempts. `invalid_response`: CoinGecko returned a body that could not be parsed as JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

granularity.description: Point spacing CoinGecko applied for this span (computed from the requested range).

id.description: CoinGecko slug the series is for.

marketCaps.description: Market-cap series over the same window.

t.description: Timestamp in Unix MILLISECONDS (note: /simple/price uses seconds).

value.description: Value at this timestamp (price, market cap, or volume in vs_currency).

prices.description: Price series. Data provided by CoinGecko.

t.description: Timestamp in Unix MILLISECONDS (note: /simple/price uses seconds).

value.description: Value at this timestamp (price, market cap, or volume in vs_currency).

volumes.description: Volume series over the same window.

t.description: Timestamp in Unix MILLISECONDS (note: /simple/price uses seconds).

value.description: Value at this timestamp (price, market cap, or volume in vs_currency).

vsCurrency.description: Currency the series is denominated in.
